cooking.name: Scrambled eggs
cooking.steps: Whisk 2 eggs with salt. Butter pan on low heat. Stir gently until soft curds. Finish with pepper.

cooking.name: Overnight oats
cooking.steps: Mix 1/2 cup oats, 1/2 cup milk, 1 tbsp chia, honey. Refrigerate overnight. Top with fruit.

cooking.name: Chicken stir-fry
cooking.steps: Slice chicken, marinate soy+ginger. Stir-fry veggies 3 min. Add chicken 5 min. Serve over rice.

calisthenics.steps: Dead hang 30s → scapular pulls → negative pull-ups → full pull-up. 3x/week.
Wall push-ups → knee push-ups → standard → diamond → one-arm. 3x/week.
Tuck sit → one-leg L-sit → full L-sit. Hold 10-30s. 3x/week.
